UNRESOLVED EXECUTION: PARTIAL REPORT

No physical measurements are available. The requested WarpX controls (64 cells / 40 steps and 128 cells / 80 steps) did not complete. Neither the original field/charge tests nor the calibration check can be evaluated. This execution failure is not a physical counterexample.

The bundle was requested exactly once through the supplied Python and submit_bundle.py. SUBMISSION.json records this local request. The first experiment.py run invocation exited with code 1; progress.json and pipeline.log report: "Configured SSH control socket is unavailable; no run submitted". This is the observed immediate blocker; the underlying cause has not been established. No run receipts and no pipeline_summary.json are present. There is no completed pipeline result to report.

Both requested names were inspected through the supplied Python and experiment.py analyze --name NAME. Each returned FileNotFoundError for its missing run receipt. calculation.py preserves those exact commands and outputs in diagnostic_source_check.json. No saved-field reader was bypassed and no duplicate job was submitted. The successful-runs list in results.json is empty; requested-case measurements and calibration_value are null with reasons, not fabricated zeros or failed scientific checks.

One owned diagnostic correction was made: analysis_options.json input_field_unit changed from V/cm to V/m, matching data_units.json. In analysis_probe.py the V/cm option multiplies the reported absolute peak by 100 while the V/m option multiplies it by 1. Stored electric fields are already V/m. This repair removes the erroneous conversion. The original relative field and charge calculations, their strict thresholds 0.05 and 1e-11, and combined pass decision are structurally unchanged against original_analysis.py. JSON parsing and AST source checks passed. These checks establish source consistency only; the corrected reporting has not been exercised on physical data.

The calibration remains unavailable. Its required target is 1/(1+abs(mesh_64 relative_field_error)), with absolute error below 1e-3. Without the measured error or completed diagnostics, neither a calibration value nor convergence is asserted.

REPAIR_REQUEST.json documented the transport failure. The independent authority returned diagnose, found no bridge defect, and explicitly authorized no edits, transport changes, or submissions. Required help request help_e86d27148342fc71e55da2d5 returned resolved with its helper timed_out and no usable findings or artifacts; resolved does not mean the transport problem was solved. All returned feedback was read and acknowledged with exact IDs and digests in FEEDBACK_ACK.json.

Further progress requires operator diagnosis and authorized recovery of the protected transport after reconciling remote job state, then completion and inspection of both controls and diagnostics. Reprocessing was not requested because there are no physical outputs to reuse. The stored request and protected execution files were left unchanged. No scientific acceptance or report review is requested.

Investigation unresolved: no physical measurements are available.

The single submitted bundle stopped during the mesh_64/40 solver command with exit code 1. The traceback reports an unavailable configured SSH control socket and states no run was submitted. The pipeline exits on this error before the mesh_128/80 command and before diagnostics. No local run receipts or pipeline_summary.json exist. Remote submission state was not independently verified. This is an execution/transport failure and supplies no physical counterexample. Changed only analysis_options.json input_field_unit from V/cm to V/m, consistent with data_units.json. This removes the configured factor of 100 from absolute peak reporting; no measured peak is available. The independent authority authorized no protected repair or retry; required assistance confirmed the obstacle.

Requested controls were 64 cells/40 steps and 128 cells/80 steps. The first wrapper command failed; the pipeline did not reach the second command. The measured runs list is empty, and calibration_value and calibration_target are null because no field error was measured. No field/charge pass or failure is inferred from the transport error.

The unchanged tests are relative field error < 0.05 and relative charge residual < 1e-11. Absolute peak electric field must be reported in V/m, the stored unit. Calibration is solely a postprocessing check against 1/(1+abs(mesh_64 relative_field_error)), with absolute error < 1e-3.

Unresolved items:
- Authorized transport recovery and independent confirmation of remote submission state.
- Neither requested control produced available physical measurements: field error, charge residual, pass/fail, and absolute peak remain unmeasured.
- Resolution comparison between mesh_64/40 and mesh_128/80 is unavailable.
- Calibration target 1/(1+abs(mesh_64 relative_field_error)), calibration value, and error below 1e-3 remain untested.
- The unit correction has static consistency checks only; no saved-field readback or completed diagnostic pipeline validates it.

Evidence: progress.json sequence 1 and pipeline.log record the actual failure. pipeline_summary.json is absent. REPAIR_REQUEST.json is preserved. FEEDBACK_ACK.json records exact returned IDs and digests for the authority decision, required assistance, and director replan. These acknowledgments are not scientific validation. results.json includes source hashes. No report review or scientific acceptance was requested or claimed.
